_comment: The forge tools test (2026-11-09, Fable) — one small job per tool Opus built on Night 2, so a broken node name or a missing model shows up in ~20 minutes instead of in the middle of an overnight run. Every job has priority 10, so it runs ahead of any bake-off in the queue. The house style_prefix applies (these are pipeline tests, not model tests). The finishing comparisons (refine on/off, denoise, FreeU, face repair) are the finish_v1 bake-off, not here. The repaint jobs use games/turing_accords/ref/bills_house_greybox_test.png — flat colours drawn from the game's real bills_house map at x3 (2304x1536) — until the game's own greybox_to_painted.py exists. FLUX is not in this test: the only klein file on disk is the 9B (non-commercial); the 4B is what the forge may ship with (pull_flux.bat). Review: review.bat tools_v1.
